paper: Shah et al., GNM: A General Navigation Model to Drive Any Robot

reference_value.caveat: config/gnm.yaml line 1 states 'this model uses private datasets', so the reference was computed over a mixture that includes corpora we cannot obtain

objective.note: same evaluator, objective and population as the ViNT G0.c arm, for comparability

result.repeatability: EXACT — bitwise identical across two runs

random_init_control.role: instrument sanity only; never used to define a reproduction tolerance

comparison.reading: GNM deviates ~4x further than ViNT. Consistent with GNM's reference mixture including private datasets, so our single-corpus GO Stanford reconstruction is a more distant estimand than it was for ViNT.

why_not_reproduced: the reference is a checkpoint-associated value over a mixture that includes private datasets. No preregistered reproduction tolerance existed, and none is invented after seeing the result; the delta is reported descriptively.
why_not_failed: nothing failed. The evaluation path executed over the full declared population with exact repeatability and 17.6x separation from random initialisation.
not_a_g0c_arm: run under runs/trackA/, not runs/g0c/. G0.c was preregistered for ViNT; claiming a preregistered gate arm for GNM would be false.
claim_boundary: Establishes that the official GNM evaluation path executes over official data with a released checkpoint. Establishes nothing about Hospital, scene admission, sim-to-real, or navigation performance in deployment.
